retry_rule.replacement_rule: Replace all six original case rows with their retry rows if and only if all six retries have top-level errors=0 and Planner runtime_errors=0. Replacement is unconditional on correctness or reward.
retry_rule.failure_rule: If any of the six retries still has a runtime error, do not compute the V12 objective and do not make additional selective retries.

anti_selection_invariants: Every case flagged by the finalizer is retried exactly once.
No passing or non-error case is retried.
No original/retry row is selected based on action, reward, or correctness.
The larger reference remains excluded from checkpoint selection.
